final: WITH rating_metrics AS (SELECT rating, AVG(length) AS avg_length, AVG(rental_rate * 1.0 / rental_duration) AS per_day_price FROM film GROUP BY rating), above_mean AS (SELECT *, AVG(per_day_price) OVER () AS cross_rating_mean FROM rating_metrics) SELECT AVG(avg_length) AS avg_of_avg_lengths, AVG(per_day_price) AS avg_per_day_price, AVG(per_day_price - cross_rating_mean) AS avg_excess_over_mean FROM above_mean WHERE per_day_price > cross_rating_mean
